# Execution Log

## Task Summary

實作統一入口腳本 ticket.py 和所有子命令模組。

---

## Command Structure

### ticket.py 入口

```python
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""ticket-system 統一入口"""

import argparse
from commands import create, track, handoff, resume

def main():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(prog='ticket')
    subparsers = parser.add_subparsers(dest='command', required=True)

    # 註冊子命令
    create.register(subparsers)
    track.register(subparsers)
    handoff.register(subparsers)
    resume.register(subparsers)

    args = parser.parse_args()
    args.func(args)

if __name__ == '__main__':
    main()
```

### 子命令格式

| 命令 | 格式 | 說明 |
|------|------|------|
| create | `ticket create --version X --wave Y --action Z --target T` | 建立 Ticket |
| track | `ticket track summary/query/claim/complete <id>` | 追蹤 Ticket |
| handoff | `ticket handoff [--to-parent/--to-child/--to-sibling]` | 任務交接 |
| resume | `ticket resume <id>` | 恢復任務 |
